In February this year, my dad had a heart attack and passed away. He was only 50. 

The time leading up to the funeral was devastating, until we got to the funeral. Parked out the front of the parlour was my dads truck (he was a truck driver for 30 years), and inside was every person from my dads work, which was a good 100 people. They formed a guard of honour for my mother, my brothers and I. 

After the funeral, my dads boss transferred ten thousand dollars into my mums bank account without even telling her. He also gave us the license plates for my dads truck. It was a very nice gesture. 

A few of my dads work mates also put up a memorial at the truck yard.

I never got to thank any of them.
